'''''Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge''''' is a [[canon]] [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] miniseries written by [[Ethan Sacks]] and illustrated by [[Will Sliney]] as a [[Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge (media project)|tie-in]] to the [[Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge|''Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge'']] theme park. The series takes place between [[Star Wars: Episode VIII The Last Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VIII ''The Last Jedi'']] and [[Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker|''Star Wars'': Episode IX ''The Rise of Skywalker'']] with long flashback scenes to other years and focuses on the [[Black Spire Outpost]] on the [[planet]] [[Batuu]]. The series was published by [[Marvel Comics]] between [[April 24]] and [[August 28]], [[2019]].
